findings.finding: Forbidden practices across linked accounts may trigger termination across contracts.

Risk hygiene: >50% trades under 2 min or majority profit from them; negative risk/reward criterion >60% setups below 0.9x planned risk; stopless pattern ≥50%; minimum 10 closed trades for pattern assessment. Negative R/R first detection warning only.
Four-tier strikes: first RMG restrictions, second 70% split and 50% violation-profit deduction, third 60% split and 100% deduction, fourth discontinuation; add-on temporarily overridden.
Max 30% margin, 1% planned risk per idea, stop within 3 minutes; deductions applied to net eligible profits before split, can reduce payment to zero without account closure.

Warned status requires 15 strike-free days and balance threshold; Tier1/2 require 30 days and 10% net realized profit; evaluation behavior can cause starting funded status; restrictions can extend across accounts.
Appeal by email, target 48h review; appeal does not stop payout schedule.

Company may disclose account identifier and trading evidence for reasonably substantiated serious abuse subject to law; intentional material reputation harm can trigger termination. Not a blanket prohibition of honest review.
Refund after second processed payout conditional on continued compliance; breach can remove eligibility.
Automation allowed only for risk management; own account copying permitted, third-party signals prohibited.
